capabilities: Insert a live media block into daily notes
Match photos and videos to days using EXIF and container capture dates
Set per-block options such as date, type, size, limit, names and time
Open the daily note of a photo or video from context menus and commands
Cache extracted metadata for fast rescans
disambiguation: Not a vault photo manager; it only references media in folders outside the vault and never copies files in.
extras: Desktop only, since it needs Node.js and Electron APIs; no network requests, telemetry or account; MIT licensed and installed manually from the repository files. Optional Windows Explorer entry via a self-added registry key.
problem: Photos and videos taken on a given day sit outside the vault, and file-system timestamps change on copy or sync, so daily notes cannot reliably show that day's media.

relations.evidence: the core Daily notes plugin (or Periodic Notes' daily notes)

summary: Inserts a live gallery of photos and videos from a folder on disk into daily notes, matched by the capture date stored in file metadata.
